units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 41:25">Targ. Is. XLI, 25</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:2">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>אַגְבְּרוּ חמרא וכ׳</he> let the wine get the better of the young men, i.e. give them plenty to drink, that they may become mirthful.
